1; i > 0; i--) {\n    const j = rng.nextInt(0, i);\n    [allSegments[i], allSegments[j]] = [allSegments[j], allSegments[i]];\n  }\n\n  // Distribute segments into colorCount + bufferTubes tubes, each holding up to maxSegments\n  const tubeCount = colorCount + bufferTubes;\n  const tubes = Array.from({ length: tubeCount }, () => []);\n  let segIdx = 0;\n  for (let t = 0; t < colorCount; t++) {\n    for (let s = 0; s < maxSegments; s++) {\n      tubes[t].push(allSegments[segIdx++]);\n    }\n  }\n  // Buffer tubes remain empty\n\n  return tubes;\n}\n\n/**\n * Validate a generated level has enough complexity\n * (not trivially already solved, not stuck)\n *\n * @param {string[][]} tubes - Tube configurations\n * @param {number} maxSegments - Max segments per tube\n * @returns {boolean}\n */\nfunction validateLevelInternal(tubes, maxSegments) {\n  const state = createInitialState({ tubes, maxSegments });\n\n  // Must not be already solved\n  if (checkWin(state)) return false;\n\n  // Must have valid moves\n  if (getValidMoves(state).length === 0) return false;\n\n  // Must have at least some tubes with mixed colors\n  const mixedTubes = tubes.filter(t => {\n    if (t.length === 0) return false;\n    return !t.every(s => s === t[0]);\n  });\n\n  return mixedTubes.length >= 2;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generate a solvable Water Sort level\n *\n * @param {number} seed - RNG seed for reproducibility\n * @param {number} difficulty - Difficulty 0-1\n * @returns {Object|null} Level data or null if generation failed\n */\nexport function generateLevel(seed, difficulty = 0.5) {\n  const rng = createRng(seed);\n  const [colorCount, bufferTubes, maxSegments, shuffleRounds] = presetFromDifficulty(difficulty, rng);\n\n  // Try up to 10 times to generate a valid level\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 10; attempt++) {\n    // Randomly distribute all color segments across tubes (Fisher-Yates shuffle)\n    const tubes = shuffleTubes(colorCount, bufferTubes, maxSegments, shuffleRounds, rng);\n\n    // Validate\n    if (validateLevelInternal(tubes, maxSegments)) {\n      return {\n        id: `ws-gen-${seed}`,\n        difficulty,\n        tubes,\n        maxSegments,\n        colorCount,\n        optimal: Math.max(colorCount, Math.floor(shuffleRounds / 10))\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generate multiple levels at once\n *\n * @param {number} startSeed - Starting seed\n * @param {number} count - Number of levels to generate\n * @param {number} difficulty - Difficulty 0-1\n * @returns {Array} Array of level objects\n */\nexport function generateLevels(startSeed, count, difficulty = 0.5) {\n  const levels = [];\n  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n    const level = generateLevel(startSeed + i, difficulty);\n    if (level) {\n      levels.push(level);\n    }\n  }\n  return levels;\n}\n\n/**\n * Validate a level object — exported for integration tests.\n * @param {{ tubes: string[][], maxSegments: number }} level\n * @returns {{ valid: boolean }}\n */\nexport function validateLevel(level) {\n  return { valid: validateLevelInternal(level.tubes, level.maxSegments) };\n}\n\nexport default { generateLevel, generateLevels, validateLevel };\n","numLines":191,"startLine":1,"totalLines":191}}}

'horizontal' : 'vertical',\n        color: VEHICLE_COLORS[id % VEHICLE_COLORS.length]\n      };\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generate a single level deterministically from a seed.\n *\n * @param {number} seed - PRNG seed\n * @param {'easy'|'medium'|'hard'} difficulty\n * @param {number} index - Level index (used in ID)\n * @returns {Object|null} Level object or null if generation failed\n */\nexport function generateLevel(seed, difficulty = 'medium', index = 0) {\n  const rng = createRng(seed);\n  const config = DIFFICULTY_CONFIG[difficulty] || DIFFICULTY_CONFIG.medium;\n  const targetVehicles = rng.nextInt(config.vehicleCount[0], config.vehicleCount[1]);\n\n  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < config.attempts; attempt++) {\n    const attemptSeed = seed * 1000 + attempt;\n    const r = createRng(attemptSeed);\n\n    // Hero: horizontal 2-cell, at row EXIT_Y, starting at x=0\n    const hero = {\n      id: 'hero',\n      type: 'hero',\n      x: 0,\n      y: EXIT_Y,\n      width: 2,\n      height: 1,\n      orientation: 'horizontal',\n      color: '#E74C3C'\n    };\n\n    const vehicles = [hero];\n\n    // Add random blockers\n    for (let v = 0; v < targetVehicles - 1; v++) {\n      const placed = tryPlaceVehicle(vehicles, r, v);\n      if (placed) vehicles.push(placed);\n    }\n\n    // Build level object\n    const level = {\n      version: 1,\n      id: `pe-gen-${difficulty}-${index}-${seed}`,\n      title: `Generated Level ${index + 1}`,\n      difficulty: difficulty === 'easy' ? 3 : difficulty === 'medium' ? 6 : 9,\n      grid: {\n        width: GRID_SIZE,\n        height: GRID_SIZE,\n        vehicles,\n        exit: { x: GRID_SIZE, y: EXIT_Y, direction: 'right' }\n      },\n      targetMoves: 0,\n      maxMoves: 50\n    };\n\n    // Solver verify\n    const solution = solve(level);\n    if (!solution) continue;\n\n    const cost = solution.cost;\n    if (cost >= config.minMoves && cost <= config.maxMoves) {\n      level.targetMoves = cost;\n      level.difficulty = difficulty === 'easy' ? 2 + Math.round(cost / 4)\n                       : difficulty === 'medium' ? 5 + Math.round(cost / 8)\n                       : 8 + Math.round(cost / 15);\n      return level;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Validate a generated level using BFS.\n *\n * @param {Object} level\n * @returns {{ valid: boolean, reason: string }}\n */\nexport function validateLevel(level) {\n  if (!level.grid.vehicles.some(v => v.type === 'hero')) {\n    return { valid: false, reason: 'No hero vehicle' };\n  }\n\n  const solution = solve(level);\n  if (!solution) {\n    return { valid: false, reason: 'Level is unsolvable' };\n  }\n\n  return { valid: true, reason: `Solvable in ${solution.cost} moves` };\n}\n\n/**\n * Generate a batch of validated levels.\n *\n * @param {number} baseSeed\n * @param {'easy'|'medium'|'hard'} difficulty\n * @param {number} count\n * @returns {Object[]}\n */\nexport function generateBatch(baseSeed, difficulty, count) {\n  const levels = [];\n  let seed = baseSeed;\n  let attempts = 0;\n  const maxAttempts = count * 20;\n\n  while (levels.length < count && attempts < maxAttempts) {\n    const level = generateLevel(seed, difficulty, levels.length);\n    if (level) {\n      levels.push(level);\n    }\n    seed += 1;\n    attempts++;\n  }\n\n  return levels;\n}\n\nexport default { generateLevel, validateLevel, generateBatch };\n","numLines":212,"startLine":1,"totalLines":212}}}
